summary: Lenovo Ideapad Gaming 3 (15ACH6 / 82k2) - System State Baseline
detected_fault: Battery draining while gaming, even when plugged in
suggested_solution: Check for updates through Lenovo Vantage software
Use Conservation mode to preserve battery health
Consider using a higher-wattage charger (170W or above)
Disable CPU boost and limit game FPS using MSI Afterburner
